about: A free PDF editor for Windows that can also export to Word and other formats.

prs.title: Exported PDF text keeps the spaces between words
prs.broken: Many PDFs place words apart without a space character. Exporting them to Word, Markdown or text glued words together, and table cells ran into each other, so 1 and 2.50 became 12.50.
prs.changed: I made it add a space wherever the gap between letters is as wide as a word gap, while keeping each piece's own font.
prs.matters: Exported papers read as normal sentences and table numbers stay correct.
